description.value: Derby Reach Regional Park is a Metro Vancouver regional park along the Fraser River in Langley, featuring trails through forest, wetland, and heritage farmland. The park sits on the Fraser River floodplain and offers a mix of riverside and upland walking and cycling paths. It is a pleasant stop for touring cyclists riding through the Lower Mainland's eastern communities.

OSM confirms this is a nature reserve operated by Metro Vancouver with public access. No specific amenity information (bike parking, washrooms, water) is mentioned in the website text. As a Metro Vancouver regional park it almost certainly has washrooms and trail access, but I cannot confirm from the evidence provided, so those remain null.
